_tx.description: A committed transaction, read from the journal: one call to apply(), whose changes all committed together.

seq.description: its place in the journal's total order, the cursor a feed holds

via.description: the session, connector or other entity it was made through

_change.description: One component a transaction wrote or removed, read from the journal.

comp.description: the component it wrote or removed; entity for a deletion

value.description: the properties it wrote; absent where it removed the component

history.title: Read an entity’s history
history.description: List every committed transaction that touched one entity, newest first. Each is returned as the patch it applied (the named groups of fields it wrote, or $delete if it deleted the record) stamped with who wrote it, when, and through which tool or process. The journal is written inside the same transaction as the change, so this gives attribution and a diff without a version table. It covers changes made since this graph started journaling.

entity.description: record whose history to read: human-readable id, registered name, or unique entity id (eid)

limit.description: return at most this many transactions, counting back from the newest
